min_bars_quote: How many candles are needed? Three.
max_bars_quote: It should be between three and 10.
bars_note: Counted inclusive of both swing closes (A and B). Three candles = one down, one up, then down again supports inclusive counting; the exact 10 vs 9 edge is interpretation, so the backtest reports bars as a column.
min_rsi_diff_quote: Sometimes there is divergence in decimals and that will also be acceptable.
